summary.result: In general, it has shown that the design floods by the Wakeby distribution using the methods of the probability weighted moments are closer to those of the observed data in comparison with those obtained by the GEV distribution.
summary.background: The purpose of this study is to derive optimal design floods by the Wakeby distribution model using the probability weighted moments.
summary.method: Parameters for the Wakeby distribution were estimated by the probability weighted moments for the annual flood flows of the applied watersheds.
